t: This is number nine, Kensington Palace Gardens, a building in Kensington and Chelsea. It was designed by Sydney Smirke, a British architect who lived from 1798 to 1877. Smirke is the person credited with the design here, so the house is his work. The material I have on this building is thin, so I won't claim more than that. Take a moment to look at the facade and the street it sits on, and think of it as the product of one architect's hand.
